pins.name: VIN-
pins.notes: To the load. Measured circuit only, up to 26 V

pins.name: VIN+
pins.notes: From the supply. Measured circuit only, up to 26 V

gotchas.text: With the usual 0.1 Ω shunt it measures up to 3.2 A (±320 mV across the shunt), and the bus voltage up to 26 V.

source.title: TI INA219 datasheet
source.section: Electrical characteristics: shunt voltage range ±320 mV, bus voltage 0 to 26 V

gotchas.text: Put it in series on the positive side: supply + to VIN+, VIN− to the load.

sources.title: Texas Instruments INA219 datasheet
sources.section: Serial bus address: A0/A1 select 0x40 to 0x4F (boards expose 0x40, 0x41, 0x44, 0x45)
